skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature of PPP investments
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recognize and understand the essence of PPP investments, the role of PPP investments, and the selection process for investors and types of PPP contracts.
Analyze the selection process for investors and types of PPP contracts.
Calculate and evaluate the financial effectiveness of PPP projects.
Understand and analyze risks associated with PPP projects and methods to mitigate and allocate these risks.
Understand and analyze government management of PPP in Vietnam.
Possess research and analytical skills related to PPP investments.
Have the ability to learn independently, identify problems, analyze and solve problems.
Work effectively in teams to complete group tasks.
